_metadata.description: SIEM parser configuration for agent-telemetry JSON events
_metadata.note: All CIM-standardized fields are at the top level. The 'data' object contains framework-specific extras only (e.g. ADK tool_sequence, OpenAI trigger_tool).

event_type.description: Canonical event type — same value regardless of source framework

framework.description: Source framework: adk | claude | openai | langgraph | pydantic-ai | copilot | mcp

trace_id.description: Distributed trace identifier (ULID). Groups all events across agent delegations in one request.

session_id.description: Session/conversation identifier (ULID). Groups all events in one conversation.

model_name.description: LLM model name (gemini-2.5-flash, gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-6, etc.)

user_id.description: User identifier (from event data or AGENT_TELEMETRY_USER_ID env var)

input_tokens.description: Input token count for model call (native or tiktoken-estimated)

output_tokens.description: Output token count for model response (native or estimated)

total_tokens.description: Total tokens for this model call (input + output)

cached_tokens.description: Tokens served from prompt cache (prompt cache hits)

cost_usd.description: Estimated cost in USD for this model call

session_cost_usd.description: Cumulative session cost in USD at time of event

threshold_usd.description: Configured cost threshold that was exceeded (cost_threshold_exceeded events)

exceeded.description: True when cost threshold was crossed (cost_threshold_exceeded events)

error_type_name.description: Python exception class name (e.g. TimeoutError, ResourceExhausted, RuntimeError)

error_class.description: Error category bucket: timeout | rate_limit | auth | network | tool_error

is_retryable.description: Whether the error is safe to retry

tool_args.description: Serialized tool input arguments (only when capture_tool_data=True)

tool_result.description: Serialized tool output / result (only when capture_tool_data=True)

user_message_text.description: User prompt text — stripped on hot path for PII protection

has_injection_patterns.description: True when user input matched known prompt injection patterns

injection_patterns.description: List of injection pattern names detected in user input

source_agent.description: Agent initiating a handoff (agent_handoff / agent_handoff_error events)

triggered_rules.description: List of detection rule names that fired on this event (evaluated at emit time by the agent_telemetry library). Null when no rules matched.

max_severity.description: Highest severity among triggered rules: high | medium | low. Null when triggered_rules is null.

source.description: Agent source tier: sdk_agent (full telemetry fidelity) | cloud_agent (MCP-only, dark fields). Use to split behavioral models and detection rules by tier.

estimated.description: True when token counts / costs are synthesized from payload size rather than native API values. Always True for cloud_agent source events.

telemetry_completeness.description: Ratio of populated CIM fields out of total expected (0.0-1.0). Cloud agents typically score 0.4-0.6 due to dark model-level fields. Use to weight anomaly detection confidence.

data.description: Framework-specific extras not in the CIM schema (ADK: tool_sequence, delegation_depth; OpenAI: trigger_tool, tools, handoffs; Copilot: tool_type connector/power-automate; MCP: tool_call_count, telemetry_completeness). Null when empty.

detection_rules_note: Rules are evaluated by the agent_telemetry library at emit time. Results appear in triggered_rules[] and max_severity on every matching event. Use these simple queries instead of evaluating conditions yourself.

detection_rules.name: Prompt Injection Detected
detection_rules.description: User input matched known prompt injection patterns — review injection_patterns field for specifics

detection_rules.name: Cost Threshold Exceeded
detection_rules.description: Cumulative session cost crossed the configured threshold

detection_rules.name: Agent Depth Exceeded
detection_rules.description: Agent delegation chain exceeded max depth — possible runaway recursion

detection_rules.name: Model Error - Rate Limited
detection_rules.description: LLM API rate limit hit — may indicate abuse or misconfiguration

detection_rules.name: Model Error - Auth Failure
detection_rules.description: LLM API authentication failure — possible credential compromise

detection_rules.name: Tool Error
detection_rules.description: Tool invocation failed — check error_message and is_retryable

detection_rules.name: Agent Handoff Error
detection_rules.description: Agent-to-agent handoff failed — target agent unavailable

detection_rules.name: High Token Usage
detection_rules.description: Single model call consumed excessive tokens

detection_rules.name: High Single-Call Cost
detection_rules.description: Single model call cost exceeded $0.50 — potential runaway agent

correlation_keys.description: Use session_id to group all events in a conversation. Use trace_id to correlate events across agent delegations within a single request.
